notes: SeerToken implements SeerIMD (SEER), an ERC-20 with 18 decimals and EIP-2612 permit. Its parameterless constructor mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 SEER to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no post-deployment minting, burn function, transfer fees or privileged administration. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
